description: Leader-q exit sequence: with text in the prompt the app.exit binding is disabled (leader+q merely types q); once the draft is cleared, <leader> (ctrl+x) followed by q dispatches app.exit and tears the renderer down
source: test/app-lifecycle.test.tsx (exit ordering) + src/config/keybind.ts (app.exit = 'ctrl+c,ctrl+d,<leader>q', leader default ctrl+x) + src/app.tsx app.exit layer enabled only while the prompt is empty
